name: Searing Light, Lesser
body:
School evocation; Level cleric/oracle 1, inquisitor 1

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

This spell functions as searing light except the ray deals 1d4 points of damage per two caster levels, the damage to undead is 1d3 per class level (maximum 10d3), and undead particularly vulnerable to sunlight take 1d4 damage per class level (maximum 10d4). Finally, constructs and objects only take 1d3 damage per two caster levels (maximum 5d3).
